x-e-e4-01.title: Inothi likamama nesikhathi sokudlala sikaJisu
x-e-e4-01.goal: Qhathanisa amacebo amaningana kunothi likamama nesikhathi esiphakanyiswe ngumngani, uthole lapho ingahambisani khona, futhi uthi cha ngesiNgisi ngenkathi uphakamisa isikhathi esihlukile.
x-e-e4-01.material:
Inothi likamama alishiye etafuleni (elibhalwe njengombhalo kuphela, ngaphandle kwesithombe):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Bese umngani wakhe uJisu athumela umbhalo. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"
x-e-e4-01.thinking.0: Qhathanisa izikhathi ezisenothini nebanga lesikhathi eliphakanyisiwe, eyodwa ngeyodwa
x-e-e4-01.thinking.1: Hlulela ukuthi 'ibanga' lesikhathi nesikhathi esisodwa kuyagqagqana yini
x-e-e4-01.prereq.1: Amagama alula afana no-piano class no-trash
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha yonke imigqa yenothi egqagqana ngesikhathi nesiphakamiso sikaJisu (4:15-5:15).
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Beka umugqa ngamunye eceleni kwesikhathi sepaki '4:15-5:15' eyodwa ngeyodwa, futhi ubone ukuthi iphela ngaphambi noma iqala ngemva.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ezintweni ezithatha isikhathi, njengeklasi, sebenza isikhathi ezigcina ngaso.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.a: Qhathanisa ukuthi isikhathi ofika ngaso ekhaya siphambi noma sisemva kuka-4:15.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.b: Sebenza ukuthi iklasi liqala ngasiphi isikhathi futhi liphela ngasiphi, futhi uliphakamise eceleni kwesikhathi sepaki.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.c: Ngicabange ngakho njengokuhlola ukuthi isikhathi esisodwa siwela ngaphakathi kwebanga lesikhathi sepaki.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.d: Qhathanisa ukuthi isikhathi sedina sisemva kokuphela kwesikhathi sepaki.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.explain: Iklasi yepiyano ngu-4:00-4:30, ngakho u-4:15-4:30 uyagqagqana, futhi ukukhipha udoti ngo-5:00 kuwela ngaphakathi kuka-4:15-5:15. Ukufika ekhaya ngo-3:30 nedina ngo-6:30 kungaphandle kwesikhathi sepaki.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.prompt: Phendula uJisu ngemisho yesiNgisi emibili noma emithathu. Thola izizathu esenothini zokuthi awukwazi ukuya, uzibhale, futhi uphakamise esinye isikhathi esisebenzayo.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala, uthi cha emusheni owodwa nge-'Sorry, I can't ...'.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala amacebo amabili agqagqanayo avela kunothi nezikhathi zawo, futhi ekugcineni wenze isiphakamiso sakho nge-'Can we play at ...?'.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe unikeze zombili izizathu, upiyano nokukhipha udoti?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uphakamise isikhathi esihlukile, futhi lesi sikhathi asigqagqani namacebo asenothini?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe kukhona isisho sokunqaba esifana no-'I can't'?

x-e-e4-02.title: Nquma izikhathi zokuhambisa inja nomsebenzi wesikole
x-e-e4-02.goal: Yenza ukuhlangana okuhlukene okuningana kwesikhathi sokuhamba nesikhathi somsebenzi wesikole okuhlangabezana nayo yonke imibandela kunothi likaBaba.
x-e-e4-02.material:
Inothi uBaba alishiye (elibhalwe njengombhalo kuphela, ngaphandle kwesithombe):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Ngezansi, bhala isikhathi ngasinye njengo-'mizuzu emingaki ngemva kuka-4:00 p.m.'. Isibonelo, uma uqala ngo-4:30, bhala u-30, futhi uma uqala ngo-5:15, bhala u-75.
x-e-e4-02.thinking.0: Yenza impendulo ehlangabezana nemibandela eminingana ngasikhathi sinye wena
x-e-e4-02.thinking.1: Engeza isikhathi esithathwayo esikhathini sokuqala ukuhlola isikhathi sokuphela
x-e-e4-02.prereq.1: Amagama alula afana no-walk the dog no-homework
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.prompt: Uma uMina eqala umsebenzi wesikole ngo-5:00 nokuhamba ngo-5:30, wephula muphi umbandela osenothini?
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Engeza isikhathi esithathwayo (ngemizuzu) esikhathini sokuqala somsebenzi ngamunye ukuthola isikhathi aphela ngaso.

x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.b: Beka umsebenzi wesikole 5:00-6:00 nokuhamba 5:30-6:00 eceleni komunye emgqeni wesikhathi.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.c: Thola izikhathi zokuphela zemisebenzi emibili ngokwengeza isikhathi esithathwa umsebenzi ngamunye esikhathini sawo sokuqala.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.d: Lo mbandela mayelana nokuthi umsebenzi uthatha isikhathi esingakanani, hhayi isikhathi sokuqala.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.explain: Umsebenzi wesikole ngu-5:00-6:00 futhi ukuhamba ngu-5:30-6:00, ngakho imisebenzi emibili iyagqagqana kusukela ku-5:30 kuya ku-6:00. Ukuhamba kuqala ngemva kuka-5:00 futhi kokubili kuphela ngaphambi kuka-6:30, ngakho eminye imibandela iyagcinwa.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amacebo ama-3 ahlukene agcina yonke imibandela esenothini. U-w ukuqala kokuhamba futhi u-k ukuqala komsebenzi wesikole (mizuzu emingaki ngemva kuka-4:00 p.m.).
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala unqume ibanga u-w angaba yilo lokuqala kokuhamba, bese ukhetha ukuqala komsebenzi wesikole u-k ukuze ugweme leso sikhathi sokuhamba.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Thola isikhathi sokuphela kusukela ekuqaleni komsebenzi ngamunye kanye nesikhathi esithathwayo, futhi uhlole ukuthi imisebenzi emibili iyagqagqana yini.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.var.k: Ukuqala komsebenzi wesikole (u-k mizuzu ngemva kuka-4:00)
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Bhala u-w no-k njengezinombolo eziphelele (imizuzu) ezingu-0 noma ngaphezulu.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Ukuhamba noma umsebenzi wesikole kuphela ngemva kuka-6:30.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.explain: Ukuhamba kumele kuqale phakathi kwemizuzu engu-60 nengu-120 (5:00-6:00), futhi umsebenzi wesikole kumele uqale phakathi kwemizuzu engu-90 (ngo-5:30). Phakathi kwalawo, ukuhlangana okungagqagqani yizimpendulo. Izibonelo: (ukuhamba 60, umsebenzi wesikole 0), (ukuhamba 90, umsebenzi wesikole 0), (ukuhamba 60, umsebenzi wesikole 90).
